summary: Planet Green Holdings Corp. filed an 8-K on May 11, 2026, disclosing that its annual audit report for fiscal year 2025 contained a going concern qualification. This disclosure is required by NYSE American Sections 401(h) and 610(b). The filing is a routine regulatory notice triggered by the audit opinion; no transaction, acquisition, divestiture, or other special situation is involved. The company is simply complying with exchange rules to inform shareholders of the going concern language. There are no deal terms, advisors, or structural mechanics to analyze. What to watch: any subsequent financing or restructuring efforts to address the going concern issue.
